title: RadonBench: A Benchmark of Classical and Learning-Guided Search Techniques for Problems in Combinatorial Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2610.33259v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Classical optimization and learning-guided search offer complementary approaches to open problems in discrete mathematics, but their outputs are difficult to compare when search spaces, validity checks, and stopping rules differ. We present \emph{RadonBench}, a benchmark for constructing maximum-cardinality Radon-free lattice configurations: finite subsets of $\mathbb{Z}^d$ admitting no integral Radon partition. It remains open whether Radon-free configurations with $11$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^3$ or $21$ points in $\mathbb{Z}^4$ are possible. If they exist, they would improve the corresponding lower bounds on the integer Radon numbers. We compare exhaustive extension, greedy local search, PatternBoost, AlphaZero, and AlphaEvolve. All outputs use one success predicate: a convex target-sized configuration succeeds exactly when its number of integral Radon points is zero. PatternBoost and AlphaZero construct verified Radon-free configuration

translated_title: RadonBench：面向组合几何问题的经典与学习引导搜索技术基准测试
translated_abstract: 经典优化方法与学习引导搜索为离散数学中的开放问题提供了互补的求解途径，但当搜索空间、有效性检验和停止规则各不相同时，二者的输出难以直接比较。我们提出了 RadonBench，一个用于构造最大基数无 Radon 格点配置的基准测试：即不存在整数 Radon 分割的 $\mathbb{Z}^d$ 的有限子集。$\mathbb{Z}^3$ 中是否存在 11 个点的无 Radon 配置，以及 $\mathbb{Z}^4$ 中是否存在 21 个点的无 Radon 配置，目前仍是未解决的问题。若它们存在，将改进整数 Radon 数的相应下界。我们比较了穷举扩展、贪心局部搜索、PatternBoost、AlphaZero 和 AlphaEvolve 这五种方法。所有输出均采用同一个成功判定标准：一个凸的、目标规模的配置，当且仅当其整数 Radon 点数为零时才算成功。PatternBoost 和 AlphaZero 构造出了经过验证的无 Radon 配置。
tldr: RadonBench 提出了一个统一判定标准的基准测试，在无 Radon 格点构造这一组合几何开放问题上，对穷举、贪心等经典方法与 PatternBoost、AlphaZero、AlphaEvolve 等学习引导方法进行了系统比较。
